trap-superlative.notes: REPORT ONLY. Four independent findings, none fixed. (1) THE STATED ODE IS WRONG. The block gives F''(eta) - (n^2 - 1/4 + (m^2-1/4)/sinh^2 eta) F = 0 for toroidal harmonics P^m_(n-1/2). Deriving the normal form: the associated Legendre equation in eta (x = cosh eta) is y_ee + coth(eta) y_e - [nu(nu+1) + m^2/sinh^2] y = 0; removing the first-derivative term with y = F/sqrt(sinh eta) contributes -p^2/4 - p'/2 = -1/4 + 1/(4 sinh^2) with p = coth, giving F'' - (nu(nu+1) + 1/4 + (m^2-1/4)/sinh^2) F = 0, and nu(nu+1) + 1/4 = n^2 for nu = n-1/2. So the constant is n^2, NOT n^2 - 1/4. Confirmed numerically with mpmath.legenp at three points -- (n,m,eta) = (2,1,0.8), (3,0,1.3), (1,2,0.6) -- the implied constant is 4.0, 9.0, 1.0 exactly, i.e. n^2, against n^2-1/4 = 3.75, 8.75, 0.75.
